findings: Current native governance boundaries must remain above all external frameworks.
MCP C# SDK is a better Command Center fit than a Python MCP sidecar for the main .NET boundary.
LiteLLM is acceptable only beneath ModelBroker with silent routing/fallback disabled or explicitly mapped.
Cua has strong value for the DC gap but is sandbox-only until a later execution authorization.
Letta self-modifying memory semantics conflict with canonical truth and are reference-only.
LangGraph/Temporal are deferred until measured durability/orchestration gaps exist.
